title: Cells use quantum coherence to compute

statements.text: The internal molecular-scale dynamics of both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells implement quantum information processing, using quantum coherence as a computational and memory resource.
statements.falsification_criteria: Experiments that test explicitly for coherence effects in cellular biochemistry and find none.

prediction.resolution_criterion: A published experiment shows, or rules out, essential use of quantum coherence as a computational or memory resource in the molecular-scale dynamics of living cells.

sources.quote: The internal, molecular-scale dynamics of both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells implement quantum information processing, i.e., make essential use of quantum coherence as a computational and memory resource.
